testcase.name: Customer receipt and vendor payment mechanisms comparison
testcase.file: Customer Receipt Vs Vendor Payment (Tests\Feature\CustomerReceiptVsVendorPayment)::Customer receipt and vendor payment mechanisms comparison
testcase.system-out:
=== Customer Receipt vs Vendor Payment Mechanism Comparison ===
✅ Model structures are similar ✅ Both have header-detail relationship ✅ Both support multiple payment methods ✅ Both track payment amounts and dates ✅ Both integrate with Chart of Accounts ✅ Both have status tracking (Draft/Partial/Paid) ✅ Both support invoice allocation
Key Similarities: - Same attribute names and types - Same relationship patterns - Same payment processing logic - Same journal entry integration
Conclusion: Customer Receipt mechanism is implemented similarly to Vendor Payment mechanism.
